props.name: words
props.description: Words to rotate; empty data has a stable recovery state.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds per word; values below 1 or non-finite use 1 or 3 respectively.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Direct user selection callback; autoplay is decorative.

props.name: paused
props.description: Externally pause decorative motion; the built-in pause control also remains available.

props.name: speed
props.description: Motion multiplier. Non-finite values fall back to 1; 0 freezes the scene.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color; independent of the host theme.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class on the component root.
